title: Large-scale evidence: developers rarely give complete specs upfront; agent-intent misalignment at scale
summary: Analysis of 20,574 real-world coding-agent sessions shows developers refine requests turn by turn rather than providing complete specifications, and agents must track evolving intent; corroborates ambiguous-requirement gap-filling as a live failure mechanism.

evidence.summary: 20,574-session study of developer-agent misalignment; incomplete upfront specification is the norm.
